nodes.title: BairesDev
nodes.text: Led backend development for cloud-native applications built on microservices and event-driven architectures. Contributed to product launches such as Roava, a fintech, and Complex. Designed proofs of concept for virtualization and virtual networking, and made infrastructure more reliable and scalable by reworking it in Terraform and Kubernetes.
